'''furhead16 Light Side Yavin Deck''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[furhead16]]
* '''Published:''' 3 December 2003 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS1]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Forest|SE-L-forest.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Forest
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS1 Forest furhead16 LS 2003 GPN.txt |Download]]

== Introduction ==

This deck does not use an Objective or Epic Event!  *gasp*  It's a deck from the "olden days" of strategy.

The published list has 59 cards.

== Strategy ==

Start with Yavin 4: Massassi War Room.

This deck relies on smaller strategy to win the bigger war.  I use a few 'reacts' to try and corner my enemy when he thinks I am pitifully out numbered.  With the Falcon and Out Of Nowhere, I draw 3 battle destinies.  Perfect oportunity for I've Got A Bad Feeling.  Opponent has a lone ship with 10 or so power, deploy the Falcon, start the battle, play Feeling, and then Out of nowhere.  Bam.  Triple the loss for opponent, and it's gonna be big with 3 destinies.  After it's all over, tag on Legendary Starfighter to add insult to injury.

I use Figrin D'an for a small retrieval, along with Noble Sacrifice.  Captain Panaka gets out and then draws a blaster from your reserve.  Just little tricks here and there.

Remember, I have a limited amount of cards.  These are my mains.  These are my toys.  If you can suggest some other "old" combos that might work, or a V-card that would work better, I'd be glad to hear it.  Thanks!
